theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (P : Grassmannian N 0) (θ₀ : ℝ) (W : ℕ → Varifold N 0 (ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5)), 0 < θ₀ → (∀ k, IsIntegral (W k)) → (∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N 0, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5 ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N 0)) → Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ z, f z ∂(W k).measure) atTop (𝓝 (θ₀ * ∫ z, f z ∂(planeVarifoldMeasure P)))) → ∃ m : ℕ, θ₀ = m
